arrive.text: A lecture, on the shape of the world.

ladder.text: There's a ladder, over the edge of the world.

turtle_1.text: A turtle. A very large one.

turtle_look.text: It looks up at you, slowly, and goes back to holding up the world.

ask.text: So what holds the world up? And what holds that up?

forever.text: You could go on like this forever. Every turtle needs another one under it.

curve.text: The stack isn't quite straight. Far below, it curves away, very slightly.

down_2.text: There's always another turtle. The chain never ends. But it never quite explains itself, either.

last_1.text: This one stands on nothing at all. It just does.

last_2.text: The chain has to stop somewhere, some say, at something that needs nothing underneath it. But why here? Why this one?

loop_1.text: The turtles go round in a great ring, each on the back of the one before. The last one holds up the first.

loop_2.text: There's no bottom, because there's no bottom to reach. They hold each other up.

stop_2.text: Most people do, most of the time. The world stays up either way.
